successModal.message: Thank you for sharing your universe with us. Our Marketing team will carefully review your partner application and come back to you with the next steps.

hero.lead: Join a human adventure built around animals, expertise and authentic stories. As a Biogance partner for pets or an Ekinat partner for horses, you help inspire our community, share trusted advice and actively contribute to the development of our brands.

process.intro: Biogance is looking for passionate ambassador partners ready to help strengthen brand visibility, grow awareness and inspire a community built around responsible animal care. In return, selected partners can receive products, access exclusive offers, be featured across our communication channels and take part in a meaningful human adventure where animal well-being always comes first.

steps.title: Choose your profile
steps.desc: Tell us who you are, what you do and how your universe can naturally bring Biogance to life.

steps.title: Represent our universe
steps.desc: Share your animal world, your community and the content or expertise you could bring to Biogance or Ekinat.

steps.title: Grow together
steps.desc: Enjoy exclusive brand benefits, visibility opportunities and the chance to build something authentic with us.

profile.label: Partnership profile
profile.hint: Choose the role that best reflects your activity.

animal.label: My animal universe
animal.hint: Ekinat is exclusively for horses. Dog, cat, small mammal, bird and reptile profiles are guided toward Biogance.

contact.postalAddressHint: Required for potential product deliveries, contracts or event shipments.

social.intro: Tick only the platforms where you are active. For each selected platform, add the profile link and the follower / subscriber count. If you do not use a platform, leave it unchecked.

consentSection.portfolioHint: Optional — add a link only if you already have one.
consentSection.rights: I agree that the relevant brand team may review my public profiles and, if a partnership is validated, may request permission to use selected photos or videos.
consentSection.contact: I agree to be contacted by the Biogance team regarding my application.
consentSection.truth: I confirm that the information provided is accurate.

socialStrip.title: Stay close to the Biogance universe.
socialStrip.text: Thank you for taking the time to share your universe with us. While we discover your application, follow our latest routines, expert advice, product launches and community stories on social media.

path.genericFormSubtitle: Select your partnership profile and animal universe to open the right questionnaire.

neither.sideDescription: Start with your partnership profile, then tell us which animal universe represents your activity. Biogance is for pets and companion animals; Ekinat is exclusively for horses.

profileOnly.sideDescription: Now select the animal universe that represents your activity. Horse profiles open the Ekinat path; all other animals open the Biogance path.
profileOnly.pathNote: Select your animal universe to continue.

brandNote.ekinat: Ekinat is dedicated to horses only.
brandNote.biogance: Biogance is dedicated to pets and companion animals.
brandNote.both: Biogance covers pets and Ekinat covers horses.

reviewNote.ekinat: Ekinat applies to horse profiles only.
reviewNote.biogance: Biogance applies to all non-horse animal profiles.
reviewNote.both: Horse answers will be treated under Ekinat; other animals under Biogance.

default.missionCopy: Join a human brand adventure built around animals, expertise and authentic stories. Bring your voice, your community and your way of caring.
default.rewardCopy: If your application is selected, our Marketing Team will contact you to imagine the right collaboration: Biogance for pets or Ekinat for horses.

content_creator.missionCopy: Help Biogance grow its awareness and visibility through beautiful Reels, photos, stories and authentic content shared with your community.
content_creator.rewardCopy: Early access to products, features on our social media, a discount code for your followers and many other surprises along the way.

biogance_creator.missionCopy: Help Biogance grow its awareness and visibility through beautiful Reels, photos, stories and authentic content shared with your community.
biogance_creator.rewardCopy: Early access to products, features on our social media, a discount code for your followers and many other surprises along the way.

youtube.missionCopy: Bring {{brand}} to life through credible video content: reviews, routines, tutorials, Shorts or long-form stories that inspire your audience.
youtube.rewardCopy: Products to test, social media visibility, a discount code for your community and exclusive collaboration opportunities.

breeder.missionCopy: Share your breed expertise through expert videos or articles, and give Biogance visibility when you attend shows, competitions or community events.
breeder.rewardCopy: Puppy or kitten kits for adopting families, product allocation, social media features, Biogance signage and other surprises to support your breeding program.

club.missionCopy: Highlight Biogance during your events, on social media and across your communication supports while sharing beautiful moments from the show.
club.rewardCopy: Prize lots for BOB, BOS and BIS, plus samples, discount vouchers and goodies for your members and participants.

behaviourist.missionCopy: Share expert words, practical advice or videos that help pet owners better understand animal behaviour and build healthier routines.
behaviourist.rewardCopy: Product allocation, discount vouchers for your clients or community, samples and visibility on Biogance social media.

trainer.missionCopy: Create expert tips, short videos or educational content that help pet owners progress with care, confidence and responsible training.
trainer.rewardCopy: Product allocation, discount vouchers for your clients or community, samples and visibility on Biogance social media.

groomer.missionCopy: Show your grooming expertise through high-quality videos: complete grooming routines, product use, before/after results and professional gestures.
groomer.rewardCopy: Product allocation for each validated video, very advantageous discounts and the opportunity to actively contribute to our continuous product improvement.

veterinarian.missionCopy: Share reliable expert words, articles or videos that help pet owners understand care routines with clarity, trust and professional insight.
veterinarian.rewardCopy: Product allocation, discount vouchers for your clients or community, samples and visibility on Biogance social media.

ekinat_creator.missionCopy: Increase Ekinat visibility through elegant equestrian content: horse-care routines, stable life, competition moments, Reels, photos and stories.
ekinat_creator.rewardCopy: Early product access, features on our social media, a discount code for your community and exclusive Ekinat surprises.

stud_farms.missionCopy: Give Ekinat visibility at the stable, during events and on your communication supports while sharing real care moments with your equestrian community.
stud_farms.rewardCopy: Dedicated support, product allocation, samples, goodies and communication opportunities adapted to your equestrian structure.

horse_groom.missionCopy: Create practical, high-quality videos showing Ekinat routines, stable care, event preparation and professional gestures around the horse.
horse_groom.rewardCopy: Ekinat product allocation, preferential discounts, social media visibility and the opportunity to share feedback for continuous improvement.

other.missionCopy: Tell us about your project and how you would like to bring Biogance for pets or Ekinat for horses to life through your community, event or expertise.
other.rewardCopy: Our Marketing Team will review your proposal and come back to you with the most relevant partnership opportunity.

other_biogance.missionCopy: Tell us about your project and how you would like to bring Biogance to life through your community, event or expertise.
other_biogance.rewardCopy: Our Marketing Team will review your proposal and come back to you with the most relevant partnership opportunity.

other_ekinat.missionCopy: Tell us about your project and how you would like to bring Ekinat to life through your equestrian community, event or expertise.
other_ekinat.rewardCopy: Our Marketing Team will review your proposal and come back to you with the most relevant partnership opportunity.
